notes.title: 🛠️ Time to open for real! 🛠️
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Tech Market Simulator is officially launching on June 23rd! 🎉[/b]
[/h3][p]You’ve built shelves, sold gaming chairs, hired employees, and chased those 5-star reviews… Now it’s time to do it all in the full version of the game! 🖱️🎮
